name: Firecrawl
description: Web scraping and crawling powered by Firecrawl. Turn any website into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data. Scrape single pages, crawl entire sites, search the web, and extract structured information. Includes an AI agent for autonomous multi-source data gathering - just describe what you need and it finds, navigates, and extracts automatically.
longDescription:
Ships **12 skills** and **1 command**.

- **Skills** (12): `firecrawl` (Any live-web task via the Firecrawl CLI — including ordinary web research: searching the web, reading or extracting…), `firecrawl-agent` (Autonomous multi-page extraction into structured JSON), `firecrawl-crawl` (Bulk-extract many pages from one site or section), `firecrawl-developer-index` (Search issues, merged pull requests, READMEs, and documentation), `firecrawl-download` (Save a site or section as local files (markdown, screenshots)), `firecrawl-interact` (Drive a live browser on a scraped page: click, fill forms, log in, paginate, infinite-scroll), `firecrawl-map` (Discover and list a site's URLs, with search filtering), `firecrawl-monitor` (Alert by webhook/email on web changes — use for "monitor/watch/track/alert me when": recurring checks on known URLs (prefer…), and 4 more
- **Commands** (1): `skill-gen` (Generate a complete Agent Skill from a documentation URL using Firecrawl)

Installs with `claude plugin install firecrawl@claude-plugins-official` from `firecrawl/firecrawl-claude-plugin`.
